_source: L. J. Dixon and I. Esterlis, All orders results for self-crossing Wilson loops mimicking double parton scattering, JHEP 07 (2016) 116 [arXiv:1602.02107v3]. Transcribed on 15 October 2026 from the arXiv PDF text (equation numbers of v3). a = g^2 N_c/(8 pi^2); E = Sum_L a^L E^(L) is the BDS-like normalised amplitude, eq. (2.13): E = exp[R_6 - gamma_K/8 Y].
_conventions: The 3->3 entries give the coefficients c_k of 2 pi i * c_k * ln^k|delta| in E^(L)(v<0), eqs. (3.17)-(3.21); only the delta-dependent, v-independent parts are listed; '...' in the paper means further terms not transcribed. zeta values are written as z2, z3, ... Missing k means the paper prints no such term (coefficient zero) within the transcribed range; 'unknown' means the term is beyond what was transcribed.

1.note: E^(1) = i pi [ln|delta| + L] - h2 - h3 + z2, L = ln(1 - 1/v)

R6_2.note: R_6^(2)(1-delta,v,v); H2v = H_2^v = H_{0,1}(1-v) = Li2(1-v): Dixon-Esterlis write H^u_w for H_w(1-u) (their H^u_{3,1} = H_{0,0,1,1}(1-u) after eq. (3.7); eq. (3.9) is the value at v = 1, where every H^v vanishes, with the ln(delta) coefficient zeta_2/2). Until 20 October 2026 H2v had been read as Li2(v), which produced a spurious v-dependent single logarithm i pi [Li2(1-v) - Li2(v)]; the remaining terms do not depend on delta

gamma_K.note: f_0^(L) = gamma_K^(L)/4 with the BDS values f_0^(1) = 1, f_0^(2) = -z2, f_0^(3) = 11 z4/2; the four-loop term is left as a symbol G4 and solved from the data (literature value, Beisert-Eden-Staudacher: -(219/2) z6 - 4 z3^2)

Gaussian_integral_LL.note: the paper states a simple all-orders formula for the leading logarithms (Sec. 6); not transcribed; the LL coefficients above are used instead

_transcription: Transcribed twice from the arXiv PDF text with the AI assistant, in separate sessions (15 October 2026); the two transcriptions agree on every coefficient. Dixon and Esterlis state that none of the ln|delta| coefficients depends on v.

nmhv_three_to_three._source: Erratum: L. J. Dixon and I. Esterlis, JHEP 08 (2016) 131, eqs. (D.14)-(D.17): rho^(L) in 3->3 kinematics, v -> 0^-. Coefficients c_k of pi i (1+w)/(1+w*) c_k ln^k|delta|, including the constant (k = 0); the terms without the prefactor and the terms in ln|v| are not listed; there are no mixed terms ln|delta| ln|v|. Transcribed three times from the erratum PDF text (15 October 2026): the first two readings agreed with each other but had distributed the minus sign in front of the bracket of the four-loop ln^2|delta| coefficient, printed as -(7/4 zeta_4 - 1/2 zeta_3 + 3/2 zeta_2 + 15/2), onto its first term only; the third reading, made term by term with attention to the brackets, gives the coefficient recorded here and the constants k = 0, and agrees with the first two on everything else.

1.note: rho^(1) = -ln^2|v|/2 + 2 z2 + pi i (1+w)/(1+w*) + 1; the k = 0 coefficient 1 defines the normalisation K
